title: 12亿罚单刚落：美银CEO却说已经过去，监管措辞为何更重
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I'm pleased to say that the Bank of America Chairman and CEO Brian Monahan joins us now for more.
segments.zh: 很高兴美国银行董事长兼CEO布莱恩·莫尼汉现在加入我们，带来更多内容。

segments.en: Brian, welcome to the program. It's going to see you as always. There's a couple of different stories in the mix today.
segments.zh: 布莱恩，欢迎来到节目。很高兴见到你，一如既往。今天有几个不同的故事。

segments.en: We've got to start with that chunky fine from Treasury. A big regulatory fine that we can address with you straight away this afternoon.
segments.zh: 我们必须从财政部的那笔巨额罚款开始。今天下午我们可以直接和你讨论这个重大的监管罚款。

segments.en: The language from Treasury is quite damning, Brian. What's your interpretation of what went wrong here?
segments.zh: 财政部的措辞相当严厉，布莱恩。你对这里出了什么问题有什么解读？

segments.en: Look, at the end of the day, we had an examination a few years ago. We got a cease and desist order. We have to do that work.
segments.zh: 你看，最终，我们几年前接受了一次检查。我们收到了停止令。我们必须完成那项工作。

segments.en: This fine relates to that effort. There was a debate a bit about what exactly we had to do.
segments.zh: 这笔罚款与那项努力有关。关于我们到底必须做什么，有过一些争论。

segments.en: That's resolved. It's behind us. The billion and two is going through. We've been expending the money in the run rate already to do the remediation,
segments.zh: 那已经解决了。已经过去了。12亿美元正在通过。我们已经在运行率中支出资金来进行补救，

segments.en: because a few months ago we started picking up the cost structure and putting it in.
segments.zh: 因为几个月前我们开始调整成本结构并将其纳入。

segments.en: We'll get it done. We take it seriously. And I think as time goes by, people understand it better.
segments.zh: 我们会完成的。我们认真对待。我认为随着时间的推移，人们会更好地理解。

segments.en: I imagine you want to draw a line under the whole issue, but just to extend the conversation on this particular topic, just a little bit further, Brian.
segments.zh: 我想你想为整个问题画上句号，但只是再稍微延伸一下这个特定话题的对话，布莱恩。

segments.en: I imagine you also don't want to be drawn into how much of this has already been completed.
segments.zh: 我想你也不愿被追问其中多少已经完成。

segments.en: What is left to really fix here? But I think for this afternoon, given where the stock is, there needs to be some confidence for investors
segments.zh: 真正还需要解决什么？但今天下午，考虑到市场表现，参与者需要一些信心。

segments.en: that the costs associated with remedying this are in the baseline, and there won't be any more surprises in the future.
segments.zh: 相信补救成本已计入基准，未来不会再有意外。

segments.en: How confident can investors be that that's the case?
segments.zh: 参与者对此能有多大信心？
